title: Golden Jubilee UAE Getaway
itinerary_summary: Join us on a luxurious 3-day getaway in the UAE to celebrate your golden jubilee. Experience the vibrant culture, stunning architecture, and world-class attractions of this iconic destination. Enjoy fine dining, romantic sunset cruises, and thrilling Ferrari World adventures. This trip is designed to indulge your senses and create lifelong memories with loved ones.

days.morning: 07:30 – Breakfast at Cafe Arabica, Downtown Dubai (International buffet, INR 2,500 per person). 09:00 – Depart hotel by private sedan (approx 1 hour drive). 10:00 – Arrive at Desert Safari Camp; enjoy dune bashing and camel ride (INR 3,000 per person). 13:30 – Lunch at Al Hadheer Restaurant, Dubai Marina (Emirati cuisine, INR 2,000 per person). 15:30 – Relaxation time at the camp. 19:00 – Return transfer to hotel.
days.afternoon: 14:00 – Transfer to Palm Jumeirah (approx 1 hour drive). 15:00 – Visit The Dubai Yacht; enjoy stunning views of the city skyline (INR 2,000 per person). 17:30 – Walk to Atlantis, The Palm for a leisurely stroll. 19:30 – Return transfer to hotel.
days.evening: 20:30 – Depart for Burj Khalifa; enjoy sunset view from Level 124 (INR 1,500 per person). 22:00 – Dinner at Zaytinya, Downtown Dubai (Mediterranean cuisine, INR 3,000 per person). 23:30 – Return transfer to hotel.
days.transport_note: Private sedan for the full day (INR 19,500)

days.morning: 08:00 – Breakfast at Levain Bakery, Downtown Dubai (French-inspired pastries, INR 1,500 per person). 09:30 – Depart hotel by private sedan (approx 1 hour drive). 10:30 – Arrive at Ferrari World Abu Dhabi; enjoy thrill rides and attractions (INR 4,000 per person). 13:00 – Lunch at The Italian Kitchen, Yas Marina (Italian cuisine, INR 2,500 per person). 15:00 – Continue exploring the park. 18:00 – Return transfer to hotel.
days.afternoon: 14:30 – Transfer to Dubai Mall (approx 1 hour drive). 15:30 – Visit The Dubai Fountain Show; enjoy the world's largest choreographed fountain system (INR 500 per person). 17:30 – Walk to Souk Al Bahar for a leisurely stroll. 19:00 – Return transfer to hotel.
days.evening: 20:00 – Depart for Armani/Ristorante, Downtown Dubai (Italian cuisine, INR 3,500 per person). 22:00 – Enjoy a romantic dinner with stunning city views. 23:30 – Return transfer to hotel.
days.transport_note: Private sedan for the full day (INR 19,500)
